We can use the libspdm provided LIBSPDM_MAX_MEASUREMENT_RECORD_SIZE to size the measurement record buffer.
To obtain signed measurements, the SPDM_GET_MEASUREMENTS_REQUEST_ATTRIBUTES_GENERATE_SIGNATURE attribute must be set. By default, libspdm_get_measurement() does not include a signature.
